title: Three waves — animated timing record
description: Looping teaser: three wave bands slide in, ending on the timing quote attributed to Platner’s withdrawal statement.
alt_text: Animation titled “Three waves.” Three cards slide in: Wave 1 Oct–Nov 2025 Reddit posts and the tattoo; Wave 2 May–Jun 2026 texts and dating history before the primary; Wave 3 Jul 2026 the assault allegation before July 13.
